source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on SUT and check post code led.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Post code led will light during system power on.

original_test_intent: Verify that the physical POST code LED illuminates during the SUT power-on sequence.
original_method: Power on the SUT through the approved procedure while a qualified operator observes and records the identified physical POST code LED, then collect photos and unexpected-log evidence.
manual_activity: A qualified operator must locate and visually confirm physical illumination during power-on and capture evidence. Remote BMC, serial or POST text can corroborate timing but cannot prove emitted light.
required_inputs: SUT/board and physical POST LED location
Owner-defined power-on observation window and any expected color/code/cadence
Qualified visual operator, evidence method, OOB recovery and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Use only the approved power-on method and confirm the SUT is safe to transition.
Do not open or touch a powered chassis merely to obtain visibility without platform electrical/ESD approval.
Preserve pre/post logs rather than clearing them and stop on boot, power, LED or recovery anomalies.
Do not repeat power cycles automatically or infer illumination from software status.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the observation window and collect read-only power/boot/BMC/SEL timestamps.
Correlate operator photos/video with the boot sequence and unexpected-log review.
Report observations without claiming visual completion or issuing a verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply the LED map, observation rule and safe power procedure.
Observe and record the physical LED during power-on.
Review evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No executable command was proposed, which is appropriate; however, its added LED state table and cable-link wording are not source facts.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual power-on observation; use read-only BMC/serial/host evidence only for timestamp correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Single power-on observation, illumination criterion and both five-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL METHOD WITH TIMESTAMPED VIDEO
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the identified LED continuously from approved power-on through the defined POST window, synchronized with BMC/serial boot timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified board revision and documented POST LED.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, BMC and CPLD versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project board/POST LED documentation; no unstated color table is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity and synchronized timing evidence without replacing visual inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; remote events remain corroborating only.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED map, observation window and power procedure.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera angle/exposure can miss short illumination; continuous video is preferable to a single photo.

project_override_considerations: The project may define a more specific color/code/cadence and recording method. Such additions must be identified as project criteria; the library row itself requires only visible illumination during power-on.
expected_evidence: SUT/board/firmware identity, LED map and approved observation window
Timestamped photo/video proving the identified LED illuminated during power-on
Correlated BMC/serial/host/SEL boot evidence and post-test health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion agree on illumination during power-on. Missing color/code/timing detail is a readiness input rather than a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A qualified operator and platform mapping make the case executable; the physical core is MANUAL ONLY, not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree on the human visual boundary while removing its unsupported generic color table and cable-link claim.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its use of remote data only as corroboration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps the source criterion narrow and separates missing project detail from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents unrelated generic LED semantics from becoming acceptance criteria and defines evidence that can capture a transient POST event.
independent_technical_reasoning: The sole criterion is a physical optical event during a transient boot phase. Since the source does not provide a machine-readable LED sensor and asks for photos, automation cannot complete the acceptance observation; correlated telemetry does not change that.
